dishes.name: Dolo 650 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Paracetamol tablet used to reduce fever and relieve mild pain.
dishes.long_description: Dolo 650 contains paracetamol, a common pain reliever and fever reducer. It is used for fever, headache, body ache and toothache. Do not take it along with other paracetamol-containing products, as this can cause liver harm. Avoid alcohol while taking it, and speak to a doctor before use if you have liver or kidney problems. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Do not combine with other paracetamol products, and check with a doctor if you have liver disease.

dishes.name: Crocin Advance 500 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Paracetamol tablet used for fever and mild to moderate pain.
dishes.long_description: Crocin Advance 500 contains paracetamol 500 mg, used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain such as headache, sore throat and body ache. Do not combine it with other medicines containing paracetamol. Those with liver or kidney conditions, or people who drink alcohol regularly, should seek advice first. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Avoid combining with other paracetamol-containing medicines.

dishes.name: Combiflam Tablet (strip of 20)
dishes.short_description: Ibuprofen and paracetamol combination tablet for pain and fever.
dishes.long_description: Combiflam combines ibuprofen, an anti-inflammatory, with paracetamol, a fever reducer. It is used for fever and pain such as toothache, muscle pain and aches. It is not suitable for people with stomach ulcers, asthma triggered by painkillers, or kidney problems unless advised. Do not use it during late pregnancy. Food may help if it upsets the stomach. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Avoid if you have stomach ulcers, asthma triggered by painkillers, or kidney problems unless advised.

dishes.name: Brufen 400 Tablet (strip of 10)
dishes.short_description: Ibuprofen tablet used for pain, fever and inflammation.
dishes.long_description: Brufen 400 contains ibuprofen, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug used for pain, fever, and swelling from conditions such as arthritis or sprains. It can irritate the stomach, so it is best taken with food. People with asthma, ulcers, heart or kidney disease, or pregnancy in later months should seek medical advice first. Not recommended for children without a doctor's advice. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Not recommended for people with stomach ulcers, asthma, or heart or kidney disease without advice.

dishes.name: Volini Gel (30 g tube)
dishes.short_description: Topical gel applied on the skin for muscle, joint and sprain pain.
dishes.long_description: Volini Gel is a topical gel with diclofenac, a pain reliever, and methyl salicylate with menthol. It is applied on the skin over sprains, strains, backache, and muscle or joint pain. Use only on unbroken skin and keep away from eyes, mouths, and wounds. Do not apply under tight dressings or heat pads, and avoid use in pregnancy without advice. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: For external use only on unbroken skin; keep away from eyes and mouth.

dishes.name: Okacet 10 Tablet (strip of 10)
dishes.short_description: Cetirizine tablet used to relieve allergy symptoms like sneezing and itching.
dishes.long_description: Okacet 10 contains cetirizine, an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, and hives. It may cause drowsiness in some people, so avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how it affects you. Alcohol can add to this effect. Not for children without advice from a doctor. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: May cause drowsiness; avoid driving until you know how it affects you.

dishes.name: Allegra 120 Tablet (strip of 10)
dishes.short_description: Fexofenadine tablet for seasonal allergy symptoms like sneezing and watery eyes.
dishes.long_description: Allegra 120 contains fexofenadine, an antihistamine used for seasonal allergy symptoms such as sneezing, watery eyes, and an itchy nose or throat. It is less likely to cause drowsiness than some older antihistamines. Some antacids and fruit juices can reduce how well it is absorbed. Ask a doctor before use in children, pregnant women, or people with kidney problems. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Take care with antacids and fruit juices, and check with a doctor if pregnant or with kidney problems.

dishes.name: Otrivin Nasal Spray (10 ml)
dishes.short_description: Nasal decongestant spray that eases a blocked or stuffy nose.
dishes.long_description: Otrivin is a nasal decongestant spray containing xylometazoline, used to ease a blocked or stuffy nose from cold, allergy or sinus congestion. Use only as directed on the label, and avoid overuse, since frequent use can lead to rebound congestion. It is not suitable for young children without advice. Use with care if you have high blood pressure or heart disease. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Do not overuse, and check with a doctor before use in young children.

dishes.name: Strepsils Lozenges (pack of 24)
dishes.short_description: Medicated lozenge that soothes a sore throat.
dishes.long_description: Strepsils lozenges contain amylmetacresol and dichlorobenzyl alcohol, used to soothe a sore throat and mild throat irritation. They are meant to dissolve slowly in the mouth and should not be chewed or swallowed whole. Not suitable for children under 6 without advice. Speak to a doctor if the sore throat is severe, lasts longer than expected, or comes with fever. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Not for young children under 6 without advice; do not chew or swallow whole.

dishes.name: Dextromethorphan Syrup 10 mg/5 ml (100 ml)
dishes.short_description: Cough suppressant syrup for dry, irritating cough.
dishes.long_description: Dextromethorphan syrup is a cough suppressant used to relieve dry, irritating cough that keeps you awake or disturbs your sleep. It works on the brain's cough centre and does not clear mucus, so it may not suit a wet cough. Do not combine with other cough or cold medicines that contain similar ingredients. Not for children under 4 years without advice. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Do not combine with other cough or cold medicines containing similar ingredients.

dishes.name: Ambroxol Syrup 30 mg/5 ml (100 ml)
dishes.short_description: Mucolytic syrup that helps loosen thick mucus in a wet cough.
dishes.long_description: Ambroxol syrup helps loosen thick mucus so it is easier to cough up. It is used for a wet, productive cough linked with colds, bronchitis, or chest congestion. Drinking plenty of fluids supports its action, so keep well hydrated. Use with care if you have liver or kidney disease. Ask a doctor before use in children under 2 years. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Use with care in liver or kidney disease, and ask a doctor before use in children under 2 years.

dishes.name: Digene Gel (200 ml)
dishes.short_description: Antacid gel for acidity, heartburn, bloating and gas.
dishes.long_description: Digene Gel is an antacid containing magaldrate and simethicone, used to relieve acidity, heartburn, bloating and gas. It works by neutralising stomach acid and breaking up gas bubbles. Antacids can affect how some other medicines are absorbed, so ask before taking them together. Not recommended for people with kidney disease unless advised. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Ask before taking with other medicines, and avoid use in kidney disease unless advised.

dishes.name: Electral ORS Lemon Sachet (21.8 g)
dishes.short_description: Oral rehydration salts to replace fluid lost in loose motions or vomiting.
dishes.long_description: Oral rehydration salts replace water and electrolytes lost through loose motions, vomiting, or heavy sweating. Dissolve the powder in clean drinking water and sip it gradually. Seek medical help if signs of dehydration do not improve. Do not add extra sugar or salt to the mixture, and use only clean water. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.
ingredients: Trisodium citrate dihydrate 2.9 g per litre

medicine.precautions: Use clean drinking water only, and seek medical help for severe dehydration.

dishes.name: Isabgol Psyllium Husk Powder (100 g)
dishes.short_description: Psyllium husk fibre powder that supports regular bowel movements.
dishes.long_description: Isabgol is the husk of the psyllium plant, a natural bulk-forming fibre used to support regular bowel movements and ease occasional constipation. It absorbs water and swells, so it must be taken with plenty of fluid. Not suitable for people with a bowel blockage or difficulty swallowing. Seek medical advice if constipation continues or there is blood in the stool. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Take with plenty of water and avoid if you have a bowel blockage or swallowing problems.

dishes.name: Imodium 2 Tablet (strip of 6)
dishes.short_description: Loperamide tablet used to relieve sudden loose motions in adults.
dishes.long_description: Imodium contains loperamide, which slows gut movement and is used to relieve sudden loose motions in adults. It is not suitable for children under 12 years without medical advice. Do not use it if you have fever, blood in the stool, or severe abdominal pain, as these may need a doctor's review. Drinking fluids is important while you have diarrhoea. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Not for children under 12 without advice, and avoid if you have fever or blood in stools.

dishes.name: Enterogermina Oral Suspension (5 ml vials, box of 5)
dishes.short_description: Probiotic spore suspension used to support gut health.
dishes.long_description: Enterogermina contains spores of Bacillus clausii, a probiotic used to support gut health, for example during or after antibiotic treatment. Probiotics are generally well tolerated, but people with weakened immunity or a central line should check with a doctor first. Keep the vials away from heat and sunlight. Do not mix it into very hot drinks. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.
ingredients: Bacillus clausii spores 2 billion per 5 ml

medicine.precautions: Keep away from heat, and check with a doctor first if immunity is weakened or a central line is in place.

dishes.name: Dettol Antiseptic Liquid (100 ml)
dishes.short_description: Antiseptic liquid for cleaning minor cuts and scrapes.
dishes.long_description: Dettol antiseptic liquid contains chloroxylenol, a disinfectant used to clean minor cuts and scrapes and to add to water for washing. It is for external use only and must be diluted as per the label. Do not swallow it, and keep it away from eyes. Stop use and seek advice if irritation or redness develops. Not suitable for babies without advice. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: For external use only and not to be swallowed; stop use if irritation or redness develops.

dishes.name: Soframycin Skin Cream (30 g)
dishes.short_description: Antibiotic skin cream for minor skin infections, cuts and burns.
dishes.long_description: Soframycin skin cream contains framycetin, an antibiotic used on minor skin infections, small cuts, burns and wounds. It works only on the skin surface and should not be used on deep or large wounds. Avoid contact with the eyes. Stop use and seek advice if a rash, itching or swelling develops. Not for infants without advice. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Avoid contact with eyes, and stop use if rash, itching or swelling develops.

dishes.name: Betadine Antiseptic Solution (30 ml)
dishes.short_description: Povidone-iodine antiseptic solution for cleaning minor wounds.
dishes.long_description: Betadine antiseptic solution contains povidone-iodine, used to clean the skin around minor cuts, grazes and before minor procedures. It can stain the skin and clothing. Not suitable for people with a known iodine allergy or thyroid conditions without advice. Do not use it in the eyes or in deep wounds, and avoid use on large areas of the body. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Not for use in the eyes or deep wounds, and avoid if allergic to iodine.

dishes.name: Candid Cream (15 g)
dishes.short_description: Clotrimazole cream for fungal skin infections like ringworm.
dishes.long_description: Candid cream contains clotrimazole, an antifungal used for itchy skin infections such as ringworm, jock itch and athlete's foot. It should be applied to clean, dry skin as directed on the label. Avoid contact with the eyes and mouth. Stop use and see a doctor if the rash spreads, worsens or does not improve. Not recommended for infants without advice. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Keep away from eyes and mouth; see a doctor if the rash spreads or does not improve.

dishes.name: Crepe Bandage 10 cm (pack of 1)
dishes.short_description: Elastic crepe bandage for supporting sprains and holding dressings.
dishes.long_description: A crepe bandage is an elastic cotton bandage used to support a sprain, to hold a dressing in place, or to apply gentle pressure on a limb. It should be wrapped snugly but not too tight, so fingers or toes do not turn pale, blue or numb. Remove it and seek help if swelling or pain increases. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Do not wrap too tight; loosen and seek help if fingers or toes turn pale, blue or numb.

dishes.name: Sterile Gauze Pads 10 cm x 10 cm (pack of 10)
dishes.short_description: Sterile absorbent dressing pads for covering minor wounds.
dishes.long_description: Sterile gauze pads are absorbent dressings used to cover minor cuts, grazes and wounds while they heal. They should be opened just before use and kept dry and clean. Do not reuse a pad, and change it if it becomes soaked or dirty. Seek medical attention for deep, bleeding or infected wounds. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Use once from a sealed pack, and change it if soaked or dirty.

dishes.name: Limcee Vitamin C 500 Chewable Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Chewable vitamin C tablet to supplement dietary vitamin C.
dishes.long_description: Limcee contains ascorbic acid, also known as vitamin C, which is needed for normal immune function, wound healing and iron absorption. It is used when dietary intake of vitamin C is low. Chewable tablets should be chewed or dissolved in the mouth before swallowing. Very high intake of vitamin C may cause stomach upset or kidney stones in some people. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Very high intake may upset the stomach, so do not exceed the label guidance.

dishes.name: Becosules Capsule (strip of 20)
dishes.short_description: Vitamin B-complex capsule with vitamin C as a supplement.
dishes.long_description: Becosules is a vitamin B-complex capsule with vitamin C, used when diet may not provide enough of these vitamins. B vitamins help the body use energy from food. Swallow the capsule whole with water. Yellow urine is a harmless effect of riboflavin. Not to be used by people with a known allergy to any ingredient. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Yellow urine is harmless; not for people with a known allergy to any ingredient.

dishes.name: Zinc Sulphate 20 mg Tablet (strip of 10)
dishes.short_description: Zinc tablet used to supplement low zinc intake.
dishes.long_description: Zinc sulphate tablets provide zinc, a trace mineral needed for immune function, taste and smell, and normal wound healing. It is used to correct low zinc intake or as advised after diarrhoea. Zinc can reduce absorption of some antibiotics and iron, so ask before taking them together. Large amounts can cause copper deficiency. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Ask before taking with antibiotics or iron supplements.

dishes.name: Shelcal 500 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Calcium with vitamin D3 tablet for calcium supplementation.
dishes.long_description: Shelcal 500 contains calcium carbonate with vitamin D3, used to supplement calcium in people whose diet is low in calcium, and for bone health as advised. Calcium is best taken with food, as it is absorbed more easily that way. It can cause constipation or gas in some people. Do not take with antacids or certain antibiotics without checking first. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Take with food and check with a pharmacist before use with antacids or antibiotics.

dishes.name: Glucon-D Orange Powder (200 g)
dishes.short_description: Glucose powder drink mix for quick energy.
dishes.long_description: Glucon-D is a powdered glucose drink mix used to provide quick energy when feeling weak or tired. It is dissolved in water before drinking. It contains sugar, so it is not suitable for people with diabetes unless advised by a doctor. Do not use it as a replacement for a balanced diet or for treating dehydration with diarrhoea. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Contains sugar, so check with a doctor before use if you have diabetes.

dishes.name: Omega-3 Fish Oil 1000 mg Capsule (strip of 10)
dishes.short_description: Fish oil capsule providing omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA.
dishes.long_description: Omega-3 fish oil capsules provide EPA and DHA, fatty acids that the body does not make in sufficient amounts from diet alone. They are used as a dietary supplement for people who do not eat fish regularly. Fish oil may increase bleeding risk, so tell a doctor if you take blood thinners or are planning surgery. They can cause fishy aftertaste. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.
ingredients: Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA) 300 mg

medicine.precautions: May increase bleeding risk; check with a doctor if you take blood thinners.

dishes.name: Digital Thermometer (1 piece)
dishes.short_description: Digital thermometer for checking body temperature at home.
dishes.long_description: A digital thermometer gives a quick reading of body temperature by placing the probe under the tongue, in the armpit, or as directed on its label. Clean the probe with alcohol wipes between users and store it in its case. Readings vary with the site used and recent drinks. Seek medical help for very high temperature or fever in infants. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Clean the probe after each use and follow the label for correct placement.

dishes.name: Fingertip Pulse Oximeter (1 piece)
dishes.short_description: Fingertip device that shows pulse rate and oxygen level.
dishes.long_description: A fingertip pulse oximeter clips onto a finger and shows an estimate of blood oxygen level and pulse rate. It is a simple tool for home monitoring of general wellbeing. Nail polish, cold fingers, and poor circulation can affect the reading. It does not diagnose illness, so see a doctor if you feel unwell or breathless. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Readings are only a guide, so seek urgent care if breathing feels difficult, whatever the reading.

dishes.name: Digital Blood Pressure Monitor (upper arm)
dishes.short_description: Upper arm digital monitor for measuring blood pressure and pulse.
dishes.long_description: An upper arm digital blood pressure monitor measures systolic and diastolic pressure and pulse rate. It is used at home to keep a record of readings to share with a doctor. Use the correct cuff size, sit quietly before measuring, and rest the arm at heart level. A single high reading is not a diagnosis. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Use the correct cuff size and follow the manual for accurate readings.

dishes.name: Glucose Monitor Kit (meter with 10 test strips)
dishes.short_description: Meter and test strips for checking blood sugar at home.
dishes.long_description: A glucose monitor kit includes a meter and test strips to check blood sugar levels from a small fingerstick sample. It is commonly used by people with diabetes to track their readings at home. Use only the strips made for this meter, and store strips in their original container. Results should be discussed with a doctor. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Use only strips made for this meter and discuss results with a doctor.

dishes.name: Compressor Nebulizer (with mask set)
dishes.short_description: Compressor device that turns liquid medicine into a mist for inhaling.
dishes.long_description: A compressor nebulizer turns liquid medicine into a fine mist that is breathed in through a mask or mouthpiece. It is used at home only when a doctor has advised a nebulised medicine. Clean the cup and mask after each use. Do not use it with medicines not prescribed for nebulising. Seek urgent help if breathing becomes difficult. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Use only medicines prescribed for nebulising, and clean the cup and mask after each use.

dishes.name: Weekly Pill Organiser (7 day)
dishes.short_description: Seven-day pill box with separate compartments.
dishes.long_description: A weekly pill organiser is a plastic box with separate compartments for each day, helping people keep track of their tablets. It is useful for older adults and anyone managing several medicines. Keep it out of reach of children and away from heat and moisture. It does not replace a pharmacist's advice on timing or changes to medicines. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Keep out of reach of children and away from heat and moisture.

dishes.name: Azithral 500 Tablet (strip of 3)
dishes.short_description: Antibiotic tablet for certain bacterial infections; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Azithral 500 contains azithromycin, an antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections such as throat, chest, and skin infections. Antibiotics do not work against viral infections like common colds or flu. A valid prescription is needed to buy this medicine. Do not share it with others, and tell your doctor about any allergy or heart problems before use. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Use only as prescribed and report any allergy or unusual heart rhythm symptoms to a doctor.

dishes.name: Augmentin 625 Duo Tablet (strip of 10)
dishes.short_description: Antibiotic combination tablet for bacterial infections; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Augmentin 625 Duo contains amoxicillin and clavulanic acid, an antibiotic combination used for certain bacterial infections, including sinus, chest, and urinary infections. Do not use it if you are allergic to penicillin-type antibiotics. Diarrhoea and mild stomach upset are common, and severe diarrhoea should be reported. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Report rash, severe diarrhoea or allergic reactions to a doctor promptly.

dishes.name: Pan 40 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Acid reducer tablet for acidity and reflux; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Pan 40 contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that reduces stomach acid production and is used for acid reflux, heartburn, and ulcers. Delayed-release tablets should be swallowed whole and not crushed or chewed. Tell a doctor about any black stools, weight loss, or trouble swallowing. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Ongoing use should be reviewed by a doctor, so report any new or worsening symptoms.

dishes.name: Glycomet 500 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Metformin tablet used to help control blood sugar in type 2 diabetes; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Glycomet 500 contains metformin, a medicine used to help control blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes, usually alongside diet and exercise. It can cause stomach upset, nausea, or loss of appetite. Rare but serious lactic acidosis can occur with kidney problems or dehydration, so seek urgent care if unwell. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Needs regular kidney checks and blood sugar monitoring; avoid excess alcohol.

dishes.name: Amlong 5 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Calcium channel blocker for high blood pressure; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Amlong 5 contains amlodipine, a calcium channel blocker used to treat high blood pressure and certain types of chest pain. It works by relaxing blood vessels so the heart pumps more easily. Common side effects include ankle swelling, flushing, headache, and dizziness, which should be reported to a doctor. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Report ankle swelling, dizziness or flushing that is bothersome to your doctor.

dishes.name: Atorva 10 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Statin tablet used to lower cholesterol; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Atorva 10 contains atorvastatin, a statin prescribed to lower cholesterol and reduce the risk of heart disease in suitable adults. It is usually used together with diet and lifestyle changes. Report unexplained muscle pain, weakness, or dark urine to a doctor. Avoid large amounts of grapefruit juice, and mention other medicines you take. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Report unexplained muscle pain or dark urine to a doctor, and avoid large amounts of grapefruit juice.

dishes.name: Montair 10 Tablet (strip of 10)
dishes.short_description: Leukotriene blocker tablet for asthma and allergic rhinitis; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Montair 10 contains montelukast, a leukotriene receptor antagonist used to prevent asthma attacks and to ease allergic rhinitis such as seasonal sneezing and runny nose. It is not meant to relieve an acute asthma attack. Tell a doctor promptly about any mood changes, sleep problems, or unusual behaviour while taking it. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Report any mood changes, sleep problems or unusual behaviour to a doctor promptly.

dishes.name: Thyronorm 50 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Thyroid hormone tablet for an underactive thyroid; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Thyronorm contains levothyroxine, a thyroid hormone replacement used for an underactive thyroid. It helps restore normal hormone levels, and dosage is individual and adjusted by a doctor through blood tests. Symptoms of too much thyroid hormone, such as palpitations, tremor, or sleeplessness, should be reported. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Keep taking as prescribed and mention any heart palpitations or tremor to your doctor.

dishes.name: Metrogyl 400 Tablet (strip of 10)
dishes.short_description: Metronidazole tablet for certain bacterial and parasitic infections; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Metrogyl 400 contains metronidazole, an antibiotic and antiprotozoal used for certain infections caused by bacteria and parasites, such as dental, gut, and some vaginal infections. Avoid alcohol while taking it because it can cause nausea, vomiting, and flushing. It may cause a metallic taste or dark urine, which is harmless. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Avoid alcohol while taking it, and tell a doctor if you are pregnant.

dishes.name: Telma 40 Tablet (strip of 15)
dishes.short_description: Telmisartan tablet for high blood pressure; prescription only.
dishes.long_description: Telma 40 contains telmisartan, an angiotensin receptor blocker used to treat high blood pressure, often alongside lifestyle changes. It helps relax blood vessels so blood flows more easily. It is not suitable during pregnancy, and it should be stopped and reported if pregnancy is suspected. Dizziness and raised potassium can occur. A valid prescription is needed for this medicine. Check with our pharmacist if unsure.

medicine.precautions: Not suitable in pregnancy; tell a doctor at once if pregnancy is possible or suspected.
